strongs_1890.strongs_def: a log (as cut out); also well or cistern (as dug)

occurrences.bsb: So Solomon built the temple and finished it, roofing it with beams and planks of cedar.
occurrences.kjv: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.

occurrences.bsb: and he said, “This is what the LORD says: ‘Dig this valley full of ditches.’
occurrences.kjv: And he said, Thus saith the Lord, Make this valley full of ditches.

occurrences.bsb: The nobles send their servants for water; they go to the cisterns, but find no water; their jars return empty. They are ashamed and humiliated; they cover their heads.
occurrences.kjv: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits, and found no water; they returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.
